_comment: Staff-written bulletins, sorted by date at render time. This is the ONLY source for news — an automated pull from the municipal Facebook account was investigated and abandoned, because that account is a personal Profile rather than a Page and Meta's API offers no way to read a Profile's posts. Items are added here by hand until a CMS exists.
_fields: id, date (YYYY-MM-DD), tag, title, summary, image (optional, path relative to the site root), imageAlt (describe the photo; leave empty only if the summary already conveys it), link (optional, e.g. the Facebook post or a PDF).

_example.title: Headline of the bulletin
_example.summary: One or two sentences explaining what residents need to know and what to do.
